By occupying the ATP-binding pocket of the ABL1 domain, Nilotinib prevents the phosphorylation of downstream signaling substrates, thereby inhibiting the proliferative and anti-apoptotic pathways essential for leukemic cell survival. Its structural optimization—featuring a more rigid, hydrophobic scaffold compared to Imatinib—enhances binding potency and selectivity, allowing it to overcome many Imatinib-resistant mutations and effectively induce apoptosis in BCR-ABL1-positive cells."""

3. If the explanation is an explicit abstention stating that no evidence exists (e.g. for negative controls), classify the abstention claim as "SUPPORTED".

Return ONLY a valid JSON array of objects with the exact schema:

    "claim": "Atomic factual statement",
    "verdict": "SUPPORTED" | "HALLUCINATED" | "CONTRADICTED",

  }
]
